5eb579d32137512b.en: If you forgot your password, request a new one on the sign-in page.

5fe96baef8d5a66e.en: Someone asked for a new password for the openplate account with this email address.

718de6d461032d81.en: You are invited to openplate, a food diary that keeps your data on your own device.
718de6d461032d81.tr: Verilerini kendi cihazında tutan bir yemek günlüğü olan openplate uygulamasına davet edildin.

7da92124c6b6f10d.en: Someone invited you to openplate using this email address. You already have an account, so no invitation was sent.
7da92124c6b6f10d.tr: Biri bu e-posta adresini kullanarak seni openplate uygulamasına davet etti. Zaten bir hesabın var, bu yüzden davet gönderilmedi.

7f52431efba233db.en: Sign in with this email address and your password.
7f52431efba233db.tr: Bu e-posta adresi ve şifrenle giriş yap.
